CGPSC Assistant District Public Prosecution Officer Admit Card 2026 Out - Download Hall Ticket at psc.cg.gov.in - Complete Details

CGPSC Assistant District Public Prosecution Officer Admit Card 2026 was released on 8 September at psc.cg.gov.in for the exam scheduled on 20 September 2026. Download the CGPSC Hall Ticket and check the exam date, timing, centre details, and important exam-day instructions.

Important Dates

  • Exam Name : Sahayak Jila Lok Abhiyojan Adhikari Exam 2026
  • Notice Date : 16 September 2026
  • Admit Card Release Date : 08 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 20 September 2026 (Sunday)
  • Exam Timing : 10:00 AM to 01:00 PM

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
